title: 第3章 血棺悟道

content_zh:
姜辰在潭边盘坐下来，凝神屏息，开始尝试修炼。
他的武脉恢复了，丹田也不再破损。
但武脉终究不再是过去的天才武脉，丹田也只是如普通人的丹田一样。
而被修复的丹田，也终究有一些瘀伤痕迹，似经不起强大的能量冲|击。
三重造化丹虽神奇，效果，毕竟也有限。
姜辰的身|体之中，本就拥有着大量的药力，再加上妹|妹姜宁儿的心血之力，使得他的身|体里，其实并不缺乏能量。
姜辰感应身|体，以《天河剑诀》凝练真气的刹那，体|内立刻产生了如溪流一般的真气。
“嗡——”
身|体微微一震，真气流转，姜辰轻松踏入了后天武者境第一重，同时开启了武脉的四道穴位。
只不过，真气流转经络之时，一阵阵的刺痛感，让他的脸色逐渐凝重了起来。
“天之道，损有余而补不足……”
姜辰喃喃自语，开始思考前世地球上或许，在地球上，一些古籍对于修炼方面，几乎毫无建树。
但在这个世界，却明显不同。
这个世界，是一个修行者的世界。
修炼的境界，有后天、先天、真元，天元，虚丹等境界，每个境界，有明确的九重区分。
在这些境界的基础上，后天武者开辟天枢武脉三十六大穴位，才踏入先天紫气境，算真正的入门。
对比这个世界的武脉和前世的经络，姜辰发现，其中有将近两成的部分是重合的！
正是如此，姜辰一直觉得，只要熟悉自己的身|体，以他的医术，以他的针灸能力，足以解决自身的糟糕状态。
此时，姜辰思考着，开始压迫真气，让真气变得更细长，但也更凝聚。
真气凝聚，掌控起来便不会对武脉中的穴位造成损伤。

而冲穴之时，则可借助于这种更凝练、也更韧性十足的真气，进行冲|击。
减小受力面积，增强冲|击力，这是冲穴的一种方式。
这个世界的武者，是绝不会想到这样的冲穴的方法的。
可姜辰如今却直接以这样的方法，开始强行冲|击武脉穴位。
原本很艰难痛苦的修炼，如此改变之后，立刻变得轻松许多。
姜辰的境界，也开始快速的提升了起来。
境界每一次提升，都会有一种能量溢出，开始滋|润身|体，滋养武脉整体，蜕变体魄。
姜辰，正是借助于突破的契机，再加上肉身蕴含的丹药、心血之力，而给予自己最好的恢复！
这是一个良性的循环，可以将他的肉身里的所有能量，都尽数的凝练到极致，从而不浪费妹|妹姜宁儿的良苦用心！
后天武者境二重。
一直到后天武者六重大圆满，武脉开辟二十四道穴位之后，姜辰第|一|次遇到了真正的桎梏。
凝练的真气，哪怕是以旋转的形式，哪怕是凝聚成真气之针，都无法开辟出天枢武脉的第二十五道穴位。
而且，每一次冲|击，姜辰的武脉，都会出现撕裂一般的刺痛，原本稳定的情况，似乎，又变得糟糕了许多。
尝试几次之后，姜辰暂时中断。
他睁开了双眼。
他的目光凝聚在已经漆黑的寒潭上。
寒潭上，一片雪白，波光粼粼。
光影幽暗，野鹤飞舞。
深秋，寒意更甚。
姜辰虽然已经不冷，却依然浑身冰凉。

看着那一片寒潭，冷静的姜辰，忽然想到了之前那灵魂空间里的一片血色海洋。
那一刻，姜辰心中凛然。
之前，灵魂异常，出现了很明显的狂躁状态，却不知，具体是什么情况。
那个地方，是否还能进|入？
姜辰沉思着，如今心性宁静镇定，他便隐约觉得，那个灵魂空间，似乎在哪里见过，有种无法言喻的熟悉感。
姜辰的思想开始朝着眉心汇聚，下意识的尝试着过去在地球上的一种冥想方式——那是一种源自于一枚血棺上的雕纹显化出的冥想方式。
姜辰在前世的地球上能在十三余岁成就斐然，便与这种冥想方式休戚相关。
如今，他近乎于是下意识的这么做。
可这般举动之后，姜辰只觉灵魂一震，忽然如被卷入了某个深不可测的奇异之地。
这种诡异的感觉刹那出现，随即，姜辰便发现，他已经出现在了先前那一片血雾的海洋之地。
“这里……这里是……”
姜辰出现之后，便直接漂浮在虚空之中。
他明显露出了震惊之色。

content_en:
Jiang Chen sat down cross-legged by the pool, held his breath attentively, and began to try to practice.
His martial arteries were restored and his Dantian was no longer damaged.
But after all, the martial arts are no longer the genius martial arts of the past, and the Dantian is just like the Dantian of ordinary people.
After all, the repaired Dantian still had some traces of bruises, and it seemed that it could not withstand the powerful energy impact.
Although the Triple Creation Pill is magical, its effect is limited after all.
Jiang Chen already possesses a large amount of medicinal power in his body, and coupled with the hard work of his younger sister Jiang Ning'er, there is actually no shortage of energy in his body.
The moment Jiang Chen sensed his body and used the "Tianhe Sword Art" to condense his true energy, a stream of true energy immediately appeared in his body.
"Buzz——"
His body shook slightly, and his true energy circulated. Jiang Chen easily stepped into the first level of the acquired warrior realm, and at the same time opened the four acupuncture points of his martial arteries.
However, as the zhenqi circulated through his meridians, waves of tingling sensations made his face gradually become serious.
"The way of heaven is to make up for the excess of damage and make up for the deficiency..."
Jiang Chen murmured to himself and began to think about the possibility that in his previous life on Earth, some ancient books on Earth had little to no achievements in cultivation.
But in this world, it is obviously different.
This world is a world of practitioners.
The realms of cultivation include acquired, innate, true essence, Tianyuan, Xudan and other realms. Each realm has a clear nine-level distinction.
On the basis of these realms, acquired warriors open up the thirty-six major acupuncture points of the Tianshu Martial Vein, and only then can they step into the innate purple energy realm, which is considered the true introduction.
Comparing the martial arteries of this world with the meridians of the previous life, Jiang Chen found that nearly 20% of them overlapped!
Because of this, Jiang Chen has always felt that as long as he is familiar with his own body, his medical skills and his acupuncture abilities can solve his bad state.
At this time, Jiang Chen was thinking and began to compress the true energy, making the true energy become more slender but also more condensed.
When the true energy is condensed and controlled, it will not cause damage to the acupuncture points in the martial arteries.
When punching acupoints, you can use this more condensed and more resilient Qi to carry out punches.
Reduce the force-bearing area and enhance the impact force. This is a way to punch holes.
Warriors in this world would never think of such a method of acupuncture.
But now Jiang Chen directly used this method to forcefully attack the Wumai acupuncture points.
The practice that was originally very difficult and painful immediately became much easier after such changes.
Jiang Chen's realm also began to improve rapidly.
Every time the realm improves, a kind of energy will overflow and begin to nourish the body, nourish the martial arts as a whole, and transform the body.
Jiang Chen relied on the opportunity of breakthrough, coupled with the power of elixirs and hard work contained in his body, to give himself the best recovery!
This is a virtuous cycle that can condense all the energy in his body to the extreme, so that sister Jiang Ning'er's good intentions are not wasted!
The second level of acquired warrior realm.
Until the day after tomorrow when the six great warriors reached perfection and twenty-four acupuncture points were opened in the martial arteries, Jiang Chen encountered real shackles for the first time.
The condensed zhenqi, even in the form of rotation, even if it is condensed into a needle of zhenqi, cannot open up the twenty-fifth acupuncture point of the Tianshu martial arteries.
Moreover, with every impact, Jiang Chen's martial arteries would feel a tearing pain, and the originally stable situation seemed to have become much worse.
After trying several times, Jiang Chen temporarily stopped.
He opened his eyes.
His eyes were focused on the already dark cold pool.
On the cold pool, the snow is white and sparkling.
The light and shadow are dim, and wild cranes are flying.
In late autumn, the chill is even worse.
Although Jiang Chen was no longer cold, his whole body was still cold.
Looking at the cold pool, the calm Jiang Chen suddenly thought of the bloody ocean in the soul space before.
At that moment, Jiang Chen felt awe-inspiring in his heart.
Before, the soul was abnormal and had an obvious manic state, but I didn't know what the specific situation was.
Is it still possible to enter that place?
Jiang Chen pondered, and now that his mind was calm and calm, he vaguely felt that that soul space seemed to have been seen somewhere before, and it had an indescribable sense of familiarity.
Jiang Chen's thoughts began to converge towards the center of his eyebrows, and he subconsciously tried a meditation method he had used on earth in the past - a meditation method that originated from the carvings on a blood coffin.
Jiang Chen's achievements in his previous life on earth at the age of thirteen were closely related to this method of meditation.
Now, he does this almost subconsciously.
But after doing this, Jiang Chen felt his soul shake, as if he was suddenly involved in some unfathomable and strange place.
This weird feeling appeared instantly, and then Jiang Chen discovered that he had appeared in the ocean of blood and mist.
"Here...here is..."
After Jiang Chen appeared, he floated directly in the void.
He looked obviously shocked.
